features.name: fortified gun tower
features.notes: Tall central structure with a climbable route toward its top

features.name: mounted tower guns
features.notes: Placed on or around the tower

features.name: zombie enemies
features.quote: zombies that try to attack you

features.name: boss enemy encounters
features.notes: Visible along the route before the tower summit
features.quote: defeat all the bosses before getting the key

features.name: hidden summit key
features.notes: At or near the top of the tower, partially concealed
features.quote: get to the top and get a hidden key

features.name: guided corridor route
features.notes: Single directed route through one continuous space
features.quote: Guided Corridor: A single directed route through one continuous space

features.name: one way route gates
features.notes: Prevent backward travel along the corridor
features.quote: gated so the player can't wander backward

features.name: objective lock barrier
features.notes: Door or barrier placed on the route
features.quote: Story Lock: A door or barrier that stays shut until the current objective is done

features.name: traversal hazard
features.notes: Use a visible chasm, rapids, or lava field along the route
features.quote: Environmental Danger: Chasms, rapids, or lava fields
